title: [CQ-R11e4] Guest offline dependency tree stream
description:
Objective: copy one host-built offline npm dependency tree (from CQ-R11e3) into the fresh check VM, copy-only, at /var/lib/moe/dependencies. It is root-owned and read-only to job identities, so CQ-R11e5's check-mode install phase can run `npm ci --offline` with no network. This is part of the human's CQ-R11e decision, made in the architect REPL on 2026-10-30: an offline cache, so the guest never touches the network.

Split from CQ-R11e (task-001d8ab3) by architect-e4b7eee0 on 2026-10-30. It depends on:
- CQ-R11e3 (task-ab029075), for the tree;
- CQ-R11e2 (task-1e7f5a2d), so its guest-supervisor.py, snapshot-transfer.mjs and local-runner.test.mjs edits land after R11e2's.

Input, as pinned in CQ-R11e3's contract comment: buildDependencyCache resolves {tree, digest, packages, bytes}.
- tree is source-snapshot.mjs validateImport's sealed {entries, digest} over the offline tree: the `_cacache/content-v2/...` files plus a root `moe-dependencies.json`.
- digest === tree.digest.
So no new stream format is needed. Reuse R09c's materialize.

Contract — guest-supervisor.py:
- materialize() gains a keyword `mode=0o700` for its root directory, which is today's literal, so the workspace call and its behavior are unchanged.
- A root 'dependencies' mode (argv ['dependencies']) calls materialize with:
  - workspace=DEPENDENCIES ('/var/lib/moe/dependencies');
  - manifest=DEPENDENCIES_MANIFEST ('/var/lib/moe/dependencies.manifest.json', root 0600);
  - owner=(0, 0) and mode=0o755.
- The tree is then root-owned, with files 0644 and directories 0755: readable by the check identity, never writable by any job identity.
- It keeps materialize's frames, limits and exit codes (65 malformed or mismatched, 73 existing, 74 I/O) and its 'materialized' digest frame.
- Update the module header's mode and exit-code lines.

Contract — scripts/local-runner/snapshot-transfer.mjs:
- MODES gains 'dependencies'.
- A new exported installDependencies({name, tree, provider, timeoutMs}) streams hostFrames(tree) in mode 'dependencies'. It accepts only the 'materialized' frame whose digest equals tree.digest, and checks for mounts before and after.
- It shares one internal helper with materializeSnapshot rather than copying it. materializeSnapshot's behavior and its T rows stay unchanged.
- It resolves a frozen {instance, digest, files, bytes, executionReady:false}.

Tests go in scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs, beside M1-M4 and T4/T7:
- the real supervisor's dependencies mode, with an injectable owner and paths: modes, the root-only manifest, 73 for an existing tree, 65 for a mismatch;
- installDependencies with a fake provider: a digest mismatch, a malformed frame, mounts present;
- the workspace materialize rows still pass unchanged.

Out of scope:
- the install phase in the check mode (CQ-R11e5);
- building the tree (CQ-R11e3);
- lifecycle wiring and identity (CQ-R11e);
- any verified-local claim;
- .moe edits.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs (on WSL: env -i with the nvm Node 24 PATH)
definitionOfDone: Through the real supervisor, the dependencies mode installs a tree only when its digest matches. The tree is root-owned, with 0644 files and 0755 directories, beside a root-only manifest. An existing tree is 73 and left untouched; a malformed or mismatched stream is 65 and leaves nothing behind. Shown by tests.

installDependencies streams only the sealed tree, checks mounts before and after, and accepts only the matching materialized frame. Every failure is a fixed TRANSFER_* code. Shown by tests with a fake provider.
materializeSnapshot and the workspace materialize mode behave exactly as before; every existing T and M row passes unchanged.
The verification command exits 0 with its output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
